newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Lower European feeds start slow on stronger dollar.
newsitem.headline: Lower European feeds start slow on stronger dollar.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow despite lower seller prices for most products as a stronger dollar discouraged many buyers from entering the market early, dealers said.

South American soymeal pellets were offered $3 to $6 lower, following last night's lower Chicago soymeal futures close. Most other products were quoted slightly lower on the dollar and in sympathy with soymeal.
"There is still little faith in the market with the current lower trend. Most buyers seem to wait until it is clear the market reaches a bottom," one broker said.
